# Agentic Income Template

> MIT-licensed Next.js 16 + MDX starter for an honest AI-tool comparison site. Clone it, set your brand in one file, publish real comparisons, and connect affiliate links you have actually joined. It is a template, not a live site, and it promises no income.

Audience: developers and operators who will write the comparisons themselves and deploy the result on their own hosting. Not a hosted product, not a done-for-you business.

## Use it

Requires Node and pnpm (CI runs Node 24 and pnpm 10).

    git clone https://github.com/Agentic-Income/agentic-income-template my-income-site
    cd my-income-site
    pnpm install
    pnpm dev

Quality gates, the same ones CI runs:

    pnpm run lint
    pnpm run build

Optional, and only when a sibling clone of `Agentic-Income/affiliate-agent-skills` exists:

    pnpm run sync:catalog      # re-vendor data/programs.json from the engine catalog
    pnpm run audit:affiliate   # run the shared post audit; set AFFILIATE_ENGINE to override the sibling path

## Key files

- `lib/site.ts` — the only brand-specific file: name, domain, tagline, nav, and cross-links to your other sites.
- `lib/affiliate.ts` — `getLink(tool)` returns a joined affiliate URL or `null`; callers render plain text, never a dead link.
- `data/programs.json` — starter affiliate catalog with commission, recurring terms, and signup URLs.
- `app/blog/best-ai-writing-assistants/page.mdx` — the reference post shape: answer box, sortable table, honest pick, FAQ with FAQPage JSON-LD, one disclosure.
- `lib/posts.ts` — post registry that drives the blog index, ordering, and metadata.
- `AGENTS.md` — repo contract for anyone, human or agent, editing this template.

## Scope and exclusions

- This repository is a starter. It has no checkout, no customer data, and no deployment of its own; you clone and deploy it yourself.
- Email capture (`components/EmailCapture.tsx`) is a stub that says so. Connect your own ESP endpoint. No analytics is wired.
- `data/programs.json` is a dated starter catalog, not verified current offers. Re-check commission, cookie, and recurring terms before relying on them.
- The honest pick outranks the commission. One disclosure per page.
- No income promises, no invented traffic or revenue figures, no claims that a clone produces earnings.
- Do not add real API keys or a real affiliate account's credentials to this repo.
